entries.Complete <i>Ring of Swords</i> with Gara: Complete Ring of Swords with Garard at full HP.
entries.Complete <i>The Great River</i> in 20 tu: Complete The Great River in 20 turns or fewer.
entries.Spend <span color='#00bbe6' style='itali: Spend 8 XP to gain an additional 20% terrain defence (chance to evade) until the start of your next turn or until cancelled.
Spend 8 XP to fully heal the lowest-health adjacent human ally, and increase its attacks, strikes, and damage by its level. Next turn, it dies.
entries.Transform into a <ref dst='unit_Frost St: Transform into a stoat (1 XP), bear (8 XP), crab (16 XP), or roc (32 XP). Lasts until cancelled. Replaces Delfador’s attacks, spells, and passives, but does not affect hit-points.
entries.Spend <span color='#00bbe6' style='itali: Spend 48 XP and your attack to magically disguise yourself as an awe-inspiring drake. Enemies in a 2-hex radius suffer a -10% penalty to both their terrain defence (chance to evade) and chance to hit (except for magical attacks). Lasts until cancelled.
entries.<span size='small'><i>Delfador knows man: Delfador knows many useful spells, and will learn more as he advances automatically throughout the campaign. Delfador does not use XP to advance. Instead, Delfador uses XP to cast certain spells. If you select spells that cost XP, double- or right-click on Delfador to cast them. You can only cast 1 spell per turn.
entries.<span size='small'><i>The apprentice kno: The apprentice knows several useful spells, and will learn more as he advances automatically throughout the campaign. The apprentice does not use XP to advance. Instead, he uses XP to cast certain spells. If you select spells that cost XP,double- or right-click on the apprentice to cast them. You can only cast 1 spell per turn.
entries.dazed: This unit is dazed. It suffers a: dazed: This unit is dazed. It suffers a -10% penalty to both its defence and chance to hit (except for magical attacks).
entries.<i>In honor of master Heryera, who gave: In honour of master Heryera, who gave her life in defence of Elensefar against the lich Ras-Tabahn.
entries.Hey, how was I supposed to know the half: Hey, how was I supposed to know the halfway cave was warded! All I did was throw a few celebratory fire-bolts! For the spectators, you know?
entries.10 copper says he tries to firebolt them: 10 copper says he tries to fire-bolt them again...
entries.Ignore her. You’re making good time so f: Ignore her. You’re making good time so far — now cast Levitate and slip past the eye-stalks! You may need to cast it several turns in a row to keep ahead of the wraiths.
entries.I say no. A mage needs wisdom; this appr: I say no. A mage needs wisdom; this apprentice cares only for his own amusement. This one is a petty magician, not a wise sage or adviser of kings.
entries.One of these messengers rode to the vene: One of these messengers rode to the venerable Academy of Magic on Alduin, summoning a contingent of magi to support Garard’s endeavour. A particular young apprentice was especially enthusiastic...
entries.There’s no need to be so glum, master. A: There’s no need to be so glum, master. As the head of our delegation, you’ll even have counsel with the king himself! What I wouldn’t give for a chance to prove myself to him...
entries.“Kill the stragglers”, they says. “You’l: ‘Kill the stragglers’, they says. ‘You’ll have our best warriors’, they says. N’ all I get are a bunch o’ lousy goblins? Lousy lazy lying—
entries.Mages are deadly ranged attackers, with: Mages are deadly ranged attackers, with accurate magical attacks that are difficult to evade. They have few hit-points and are highly vulnerable in melee combat, so take good care of them!
entries.<i>Rain is purely visual, and has no imp: Rain is purely visual, and has no impact on game-play. If rain is distracting or reduces performance, you can disable it by opening the Preferences menu (Ctrl-P), selecting ‘Display’, and unselecting ‘Animate Map.’
entries.<i>If movement and combat are taking too: If movement and combat are taking too long, you can enable ‘accelerated speed’ and ‘skip AI moves’ in the Preferences menu.
entries.I’d be honored, my lord! But I can’t giv: I’d be honoured, my lord! But I can’t give you my name — I’m just an apprentice; Alduin has not yet assigned me one. And... I suppose I shouldn’t want to leave without my master’s blessing...
entries.Yes, yes, well done to you both. Now tha: Yes, yes, well done to you both. Now that that’s settled, ‘Delfador’, it’s time to pack your bags. You have a long journey ahead of you!
entries.The elvish border should be some distanc: The elvish border should be some distance north-east of here, through this cluster of trees. The undergrowth is so thick... Perhaps this is an opportunity to practise my new fire spell.
entries.Woses have the <i>ambush</i> ability, ma: Woses have the ambush ability, making them invisible while in forest. Any unit can temporarily reveal a wose by moving adjacent to it, but the revealer will not be able to move afterwards — even if you have the skirmisher ability. Ambushers will go back into hiding the moment you move away (even if the ambusher hasn’t moved). Woses also have the powerful regeneration ability, and have high resistance to several types of damage. Make sure you recruit units with effective damage types! To see more details, right-click on a wose and select ‘Unit Type Description’.
entries.I understand Weldyn’s stance on orcs, bu: I understand Weldyn’s stance on orcs, but Garard cannot change the facts: our rangers have neither the training nor the elf-power to fight an offensive war on open ground! What your king asks of us is impossible.
entries.My honorable lords and ladies, I underst: My honourable lords and ladies, I understand your duty to safeguard your lands and your people. And is that not what Weldyn does now? King Garard must know the orcs threaten all peoples of Wesnoth, or why else would he wage this war?
entries.You are, of course, welcome to scorn my: You are, of course, welcome to scorn my King’s call; to loiter in Lintanir; to live and laugh and linger, until Wesnoth’s strength is spent towards a pyrrhic victory or a bloody defeat. But know that I shall answer my King’s summons; I shall march to war. In honour of the friendship we have built over my many years here, I would hope Lintanir will as well.
entries.Should orcish hordes once again threaten:
Should orcish hordes once again threaten the whole continent like they did in times past, I would be the first to step up and offer my sword in service of an alliance.

But for territorial gain? I value your friendship and would honour the time you have spent here, but if Wesnoth goes to war we cannot march alongside you.
entries.Great-Grandfather, do not say such thing: Great-Grandfather, do not say such things! Deoran and his allies are risking their lives in battle, and in all the vastness of Lintanir we can find nought to offer but kind words? Force-of-arms is not the only strength of the elves.
entries.Deep within Lintanir resides our sylph —: Deep within Lintanir resides our sylph — an elven seer. We both favour and fear Elende’s fractured, arcane sight; her strands of reflected prophecy. Perhaps her visions may illuminate some measure of your futures, and in doing so help you blaze brighter ones.
entries.Kalenz leads Delfador, Deoran, and Chant:
Kalenz leads Delfador, Deoran, and Chantal down a labyrinthine path through the deep wood, past twists and turns and over winding tracks.

In many places there is no path at all, and Delfador senses they are guided more by the elves’ connection to the faerie than by conventional path-finding.
entries.To some, perhaps. The king was less plea: To some, perhaps. The king was less pleased — Garard is magnanimous towards his favourites, but has little tolerance for failure. I found scant room for advancement within Wesnoth after so much blood spilled in Westin.
entries.This sandbed is shallow, but the water i: This sand-bed is shallow, but the water is suddenly deep and a strange magic tugs at my legs! I am drowning!
entries.female^This sandbed is shallow, but the: This sand-bed is shallow, but the water is suddenly deep and a strange magic tugs at my legs! I am drowning!
entries.When that moment comes, remember... ende: When that moment comes, remember... endeavour to bestow not destruction with that fire that you possess, but the gleaming light of truth instead. Quench the flames of fear before all your world is consumed.
entries.After lengthy deliberation, and much to: After lengthy deliberation, and much to Chantal’s displeasure, Delfador and Deoran resolved to continue on with their mission. Exiting the forest after several days’ westwards travel, they soon sighted the banners of the king’s army.
entries.We have them right where we want them. O: We have them right where we want them. Once our forces are assembled, I shall join the battle personally and savour this victory up close.
entries.An orcish shaman! On occasion I’ve known: An orcish shaman! On occasion I’ve known some of the other clans to use their apprentices as warriors, but Clan Whitefang usually keeps theirs far from the front-line.
entries.What unusual magic! I don’t think I can: What unusual magic! I don’t think I can tap into whatever fundamental forces she was using, but now that I have her equipment I’ll bet I could work out how to imitate that draining attack... for our next battle, at least.
entries.There’s more of them coming from the nor: There’s more of them coming from the north! Should we attack?
entries.Hah! I think “Garard’s Wold” will make a: Hah! I think ‘Garard’s Wold’ will make a good name for the new province... or perhaps ‘Garard’s Triumph’? What do you think, Lionel?
entries.Your “warriors” only survive by cowering: Your ‘warriors’ only survive by cowering behind your slimy lizard allies! But since Clan Blackcrest has begged so-like trembling goblins, Clan Whitefang will agree to work together.
entries.Since WE begged!? YOU invited US here; y: Since WE begged!? YOU invited US here; your messenger was quaking in his boots when he grovelled before Chief Ghuvog asking for help!
entries.They sssneak off to the northeassst, tow: They sssneak off to the north-eassst, towardsss their queen! Ssshould I pursssue?
entries.The entry of Clan Blackcrest into the wa: The entry of Clan Blackcrest into the war opens a new front further west, demanding swift response. Wesnoth fully mobilizes, and a series of bloody battles at the Ford of Abez end in deadlock for both sides. The ford is heavily fortified, and river commerce grinds to a halt. Many years pass, with neither side able to gain an advantage.
entries.Delfador grows older, wiser, and signifi: Delfador grows older, wiser, and significantly more powerful. He makes a name for himself as the king’s premier war-mage, and quickly gains a reputation as a ferocious fighter. His bold manoeuvres break through orcish lines several times at the Ford of Abez, but continually become stymied by saurian reinforcements.
entries.As Wesnoth’s casualties continue to moun: As Wesnoth’s casualties continue to mount, and with no end in sight, Delfador decides to take matters into his own hands. The war-mage prepares a force of mercenary north-men to sneak behind enemy lines and determine the nature of Clan Blackcrest’s orc-saurian alliance...
entries.This is the perfect time for us to cross: This is the perfect time for us to cross! It’s dawn, which means most of the orcs and saurians will be sleeping, and there’s a heavy winter fog to cover our movements. We should have time to clear this saurian outpost and sneak past the front-line before the main orcish army wakes at nightfall.
entries.Victory is won! We have done well to rem: Victory is won! We have done well to remain undetected — the way forwards remains clear. Now onwards to the Swamp of Dread, to find out why these saurians are fighting alongside orcs...
entries.“<i>Barren Throne</i>”, “<i>Angel of Ash: ‘Barren Throne’, ‘Angel of Ashes’; don’t people have better things to do than gossip all day about this vapid prophecy? I put my trust in steel, not seers.
entries.And “<i>Sceptre of the Wesfolk</i>” is t: And ‘Sceptre of the Wesfolk’ is the worst of it all... as if it’s my fault Haldric’s dwarves lost the accursed thing.
entries.Even the wife! Ever since Delfador first: Even the wife! Ever since Delfador first told us about that prophecy, all I get from Asheviere is gossip; rumours about nobles and expeditions and treasure-seekers and other such nonsense. What do you make of it all, brother?
entries.Still, these rumors cannot be taken ligh: Still, these rumours cannot be taken lightly. Something must be done....
entries.Units with the <italic>text='aged'</ital: Units with the <italic>text='aged'</italic> trait have 8 hit-points less and suffer from a 1 point decrease in movement and damage.
entries.The Blackcrests have good reason to figh: The Blackcrests have good reason to fight, but none of this should concern saurians — they’re not usually invaders. I need to work out what’s going on with this alliance and put an end to it.
entries.female^That is, if we can find their cam: That is, if we can find their camps. This ruined place was once a great city of their kind — even what little remains is too vast for us to scour it all. This is where you said your guides would meet us, $companion_name?
entries.You’re almost there! Jus’ a lil bit furt: You’re almost there! Jus’ a li’l bit further... almost...
entries.There’s lizards out here... and robbers: There’s lizards out here... and robbers too. T’would be a shame if something happened to you. Maybe you oughtta have our protection — for a price.
entries.female^Great! Rest easy now that you’ve: Great! Rest easy now that you’ve hired us; we’ll guide you ’round the swamp and make sure nothin’ happens to you or the rest of your coin! $companion_name said yer looking for them lizards, yeah?
entries.Poachers are general-purpose nighttime a: Poachers are general-purpose nighttime archers, with numerous-but-weak ranged strikes and unusually good defence in swamps.
entries.You bandits trifle with an archmage of W: You bandits trifle with an arch-mage of Wesnoth, famed and powerful. Step forth and meet your doom!
entries.Serves them right, preying on innocent t: Serves them right, preying on innocent travellers... Now, where’s these guides of yours we’re going to meet?
entries.The “Great One”? I had thought you matri: The ‘Great One”? I had thought you matriarchs led your tribe. Tell me, elder, who is this of which you speak?
entries....decades ago, an elvish seer told me a: ...decades ago, an elvish seer told me about ‘the dark swamp’, and that I must ‘endeavour to bestow not destruction with that fire that I possess, but the gleaming light of truth instead.’ Surely this was not the event that she referred to?
entries.Not quite. Remember Delfador’s prophecy?: Not quite. Remember Delfador’s prophecy? ‘Line of Kings’? ‘Sceptre of the Wesfolk’?
entries.Good gods, why now? Wesnoth is in enough: Good gods, why now? Wesnoth is in enough trouble as it is, without worrying about lost artefacts and suicide missions.
entries.Oh Great One, you know it isss forbidden: Oh Great One, you know it isss forbidden! The malesss are not permitted! Only you and me; usss femalesss may look upon the other Great One; your sssister, our massster, our god!
I’m alive... I can’t believe it...
entries.The center crypt’s collapsing! We’ve fai: The centre crypt’s collapsing! We’ve failed!
entries.Speak, spectre! Tell me of this place. W: Speak, spectre! Tell me of this place. Where is the drake they call the ‘Great One’?
entries.How does all <i><b>your</b></i> fighting: How does all your fighting benefit you? Decades of war, and what has been gained? While you bleed for a failing country and an ageing king, your whole life is passing you by. You’re on the wrong side of history, Delfador war-mage.
entries.Elende’s prophecy rings true once more:: Elende’s prophecy rings true once more: ‘A figure of shadow cloaked in the spirits of the dead’... Good riddance. His meddling in life and death has been the cause of great evil.
entries.I am free... free! You have breathed int: I am free... free! You have breathed into me a ravenous-ness for life anew, life to drain from those who roam unfettered under the pale sun. Take us into your service, Delfador; lead us to your foes! Lead us against the living!
entries.Oh, confound it. Why did I let those inf:
Oh, confound it. Why did I let those infernal rumours convince me to send away my best general and most loyal soldiers?

Lionel is missing in action, Arand becomes more paranoid by the day, and you still speak softer than a mouse. This is war — Wesnoth needs a warrior prince.
entries.female^Are you certain you’re prepared f: Are you certain you’re prepared for this fight, $companion_name? You’re an outlaw, not a soldier, and your posse has already bled more than I paid you for. I shan’t lie and say your help is unneeded, but neither should I take it for granted.
entries.female^...fighting a whole orcish army i: ...fighting a whole orcish army is a bit more than I signed on for, but you say this is important and I trust you. I’m ready for this if you are.
entries.female^And hey, if nothing else, at leas: And hey, if nothing else, at least I’ve got to admit that adventuring with you pays a lot better than skulkin’ around picking pockets.
And hey, if nothing else, at least I’ve got to admit that adventuring with you pays a lot better than runnin’ errands for some thug.
And hey, if nothing else, at least I’ve got to admit that adventuring with you pays a lot better than castin’ cantrips for some thug.
And hey, if nothing else, at least I’ve got to admit that adventuring with you pays a lot better than muckin’ around in swamps all night.
entries.Delfador the “Great One”, hah! Now that’: Delfador the ‘Great One’, hah! Now that’s the stuff legends are made of. So legendary, in fact...
entries.“The Great” you were called by the enemy: ‘The Great’ you were called by the enemy, and ‘The Great’ you shall be called until the end of your days. Kneel, Delfador, war-mage of Wesnoth. And rise, ‘Delfador the Great’, High Adviser to the Crown!
entries.I started as an inglorious apprentice, w: I started as an inglorious apprentice, without even a name to call my own. And now I have saved Wesnoth from war, and in the process become the king’s most trusted adviser! Truly, this is more than I could have ever hoped for.
entries.Disgusting. Alduin really needs to inven: Disgusting. Alduin really needs to invent a spell for cleaning latrines. Mayhaps as High Adviser I can finally get someone to research that... (yawn)
entries.Hello Delfador — or should I say, “Delfa: Hello Delfador — or should I say, ‘Delfador the Great.’
entries.Peace, peace! Wesnoth stands triumphant;: Peace, peace! Wesnoth stands triumphant; there’s no need for quarrelling!
entries.It’s quite all right, Delfador; I take n: It’s quite all right, Delfador; I take no offence at my husband’s cruel words. Far be it from me to interfere in military matters — the king and his new adviser have doubtless much to speak on. I graciously take my leave.
entries.And what of I? This ruinous war, just to: And what of me? This ruinous war, just to satisfy my own ambition? All was nearly lost. Without your magic, all might have been. I’ve made so many mistakes, my friend.
No man is without flaws, Your Highness. Certainly not you and me. But I’ve followed you through thick and thin, and together we have always emerged triumphant.
Delfador, I couldn’t help but overhear. Prince Arand, the king’s brother? That can’t be.
entries.And... besides, I’ve lived half my life: And... besides, I’ve lived half my life fighting alongside the king, fighting to gain his favour. Today I’m ‘The Great’, but I didn’t even have a name before I first began to fight.
entries.Without that, who am I? I don’t want to: Without that, who am I? I don’t want to end up exiled, as you were...
entries.Royal cavalry, form up on me! We go at o: Royal cavalry, form on me! We go at once!
entries.Such devastation. Garard ordered us to “: Such devastation. Garard ordered us to ‘burn it to the ground’, and we did...
entries.The rebellion is broken! In the name of: The rebellion is broken! In the name of King Garard and the royal sceptre, I strike you down!
entries.female^...hey, is it true that you’ve li: ...hey, is it true that you’ve lived with elves? I hear they’re the greatest bestest most beautifulest creatures there are!
entries.All healed up? Excellent. Come out of th: All healed? Excellent. Come out of the rain and join me in my tent. We’ll soon put this rebellion to rest.
entries.I admit, I was worried about you, son. <: I admit, I was worried about you, son. ‘Soft’ I thought — if I should fall, could you truly lead our people to victory? I wanted to toughen you up.
entries.female^Listen boss, I’m not much for pol: Listen boss, I’m not much for politics, but I know when to run and that’s now! We’ve got to get out of here!
entries....hey, how come you’re not following? D: ...hey, why aren’t you following? Don’t even think about sacrificing yourself because of ‘chivalry’ or some other bunk.
entries.You will now start the next scenario wit: You will now start the next scenario with $bonus_gold total gold (plus $s11_carryover carry-over from Delfador)
entries.I <i>thought</i> I knew you... I’m just: I thought I knew you... I’m just not sure any more. Who speaks the truth? Maybe I need to get back to Dan’Tonk, away from all this fighting, and take time to think. Men, let’s get out of here!
I thought I knew you... I’m just not sure any more. Who speaks the truth? Maybe I need to get back to Dan’Tonk, away from all this fighting, and take time to think.
entries.But gold is gold, and the prince has off:
But gold is gold, and the prince has offered my wife and me a whole lot of it to stick with the ‘official’ story.

Prince Eldred knows how to reward his allies. Give up now, accept the blame, and he might even let you spend the rest of your days back in exile instead of prison.
entries.I also know you’re a man of your word, s: I also know you’re a man of your word, so I’m going to give you a choice. You can surrender, leave Wesnoth, and swear to never again raise arms against my rule.
entries.I’m not “The Great” anymore, $horselord_: I’m not ‘The Great’ any more, $horselord_name. Was I ever? Everything I ever achieved was either a lie or has already been undone.
entries.I was warned about this... <i>“Bestow no: I was warned about this... ‘Bestow not destruction, but the gleaming light of truth instead’; ‘the line of kings sundered’ — what can the seer have been referring to if not my attack on Arand? Even now, still I understand nothing! ‘From the barren throne will rise an angel of ashes’ — ‘The nameless son and the ashen daughter’ — what nightmares are these that are prophesied to arise from my failure? The coming years will be dark indeed.
entries.Delfador, I have found you at last! “Not: Delfador, I have found you at last! ‘Nothing left?’ There’s no need to be so glum.
entries.I heard your earlier words to the horsel: I heard your earlier words to the horse-lord. Do not think of giving up!
entries.Once the truth gets out about Garard’s d: Once the truth gets out about Garard’s death, we’ll have enough allies to liberate Weldyn and more besides. But only if we can stop Eldred here and now — can prove to the watchers that this coup is not yet over; that justice and honour and hope still live in Wesnoth! That’s our goal today.
entries.female^Look sharp, I think they’ve spott: Look sharp, I think they’ve spotted us!
entries.Just lay down your staff and greet me wi: Just lay down your staff and greet me with open arms. You can even have your old title back! ‘Delfador the Great’, High Adviser to the Crown — don’t you agree that has a nice ring to it?
entries.I can never atone for the lives I cost,: I can never atone for the lives I cost, but I can yet honour them through my actions. And right now, honouring them means stopping you.
entries.Humans have often pondered the workings:
Humans have often pondered the workings of the world in which they live. Some endeavour to take this beyond idle musing, to set it as the primary enterprise of their lives. Any magi worthy of the title have spent at least a decade in study, amassing a sum of knowledge which sets them apart from other people. These men and women, who have committed themselves fully to the pursuit of wisdom, stand in stark contrast to a world where few can even read and write. Their ranks are filled with the children of hopeful nobility, or those who sought an escape from the intellectual void of manual labour.

It is an irony that, with all their knowledge, and their unassuming monopoly thereof, the collective community of magi could likely rule society, were they ever to try. However, their true love is neither money, nor power, and those who see the study of magic as a means to such ends often lack the very conviction required for true mastery.

Physically frail, and lacking familiarity with combat, magi do possess certain arts which are of great use in battle.
entries.Upon the successful culmination of their:
Upon the successful culmination of their apprenticeship, a mage is stripped of the brown robes of an apprentice and given the ruddy cloak of a master. The significance of this change is often lost on the peasantry, who mistakenly title Master Magi as ‘Red Magi’. Likewise, the symbolism of the change in colours is often mistaken to signify the mage’s ability to seemingly conjure fire from nothing but thin air, a trick which, although undeniably useful, is viewed by the magi themselves as a crass application of their hard-won knowledge.

Though physically frail, and untrained as warriors, the ‘Red Magi’ have a number of tricks up their sleeves, including the gouts of fire which may have cemented their colloquial name.
entries.The title of Arch Mage is traditionally:
The title of Arch Mage is traditionally conferred only after a lifetime of study and achievement to match. Arch Magi are often employed in positions of education, or as advisers to those sensible enough to seek the fruits of their wisdom. Many tend to wealthy patrons, a profitable enterprise for both as, outside of the occasional thaumaturgy or word of advice, it gives the mage leave to pursue their research undisturbed. From this flows the greater body of human knowledge; the sciences, the philosophies, and the arts which give beauty to the world at large.

Though not trained for any sort of combat, if need arises an Arch Mage can unleash the full power of their art, something which is not to be taken lightly.
entries.Any person who is even considered for th:
Any person who is even considered for the title of Great Mage is quite nearly a legend in their own time, and town criers have forcibly learnt discretion in applying the title. Merit for the title is carefully considered by a council of the leading magi of the age, and the conferment of the title is given only by a majority vote. Regardless, anyone who is seriously nominated for the honour of being called a Great Mage is, without question, a master of their art, and has surpassed almost any of their peers in skill.

Though they are not warriors, by any means, the application of their art to combat is something that often causes other soldiers to stand aside in awe.
entries.Deoran rides an elvish horse, and has be: Deoran rides an elvish horse, and has better movement and defence in forest than do most mounted human units.
entries.This unit regains <span color='#00FF00'>: This unit regains 30% of its maximum hit-points whenever it kills a living unit.
entries.Named ‘Eyestalks’ for obvious reasons, t: Named ‘Eye-stalks’ for obvious reasons, these plant-like creatures can focus their gaze onto an unsuspecting victim to draw life energy straight out of them to replenish their own. While readily flammable and almost defenceless against melee attacks, their deadly gaze from afar is not to be underestimated.
entries.Giant Crabs are like regular crabs, only: Giant Crabs are like regular crabs, only giant. Their claws are larger than a horse’s leg, and their shell is thicker than most armour. But their most interesting feature is their water spit, which is far more noxious than that of their smaller cousins.
entries.Like most sapient races, orcs often pond:
Like most sapient races, orcs often ponder the workings of the world in which they live. Some endeavour to take this beyond idle musing, but the violent, nomadic lifestyle of the largest orcish clans does not lend itself to academic study, and the rare scholarly orc is invariably killed or enslaved by their more warlike brethren.

Orcish Shamans are rare exceptions to this rule. Respected among clans and seen as a trustworthy and neutral party, Shamans serve as guardians of orcish wisdom, and advisers in times of crisis — not something orcs tend to otherwise tolerate. By the time an Adept is recognized as a fully-fledged Shaman, she has committed to memory much of the orcs’ collective oral tradition. This much-practised wisdom has many applications, not least of which is their improved ability to draw life from their foes during battle.
entries.Orcs are sometimes capable of living as:
Orcs are sometimes capable of living as long as humans, but very few individuals ever fully realize that potential, as the average orc only sees two or three decades before meeting their end either in war or by the hand of one of their kin. Only the Shamans, isolated from the daily strife of the major orcish clans, commonly live to reach old age.

The greatest of these elders make up the Great Council, which may arbitrate the many conflicts that arise between clans of their argumentative brethren. Having practised their mystical art to perfection, these aged orcs are held in the highest respect across the various clans.
entries.Whenever an adjacent ally gains xp, you: Whenever an adjacent ally gains XP, you gain the same amount of XP.
entries.Counterspell is nullifying this magical: Counter-spell is nullifying this magical attack.
entries.They called me crazy, but I always knew: They called me crazy, but I always knew I could work out a way to block magic! I just needed to copy what I— the fake I— did during that prophecy.
No-one can cheat death for ever...
